script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: The claim that the Sabbath and offerings are part of the Law is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The claim that these commands are in the Law needs a reference from outside this passage.
The passage does not say the expert knew the commands by heart.
The text says the expert wanted to justify himself, but it does not say he wanted to know where a line was drawn.
Saying the expert is stuck on the second command adds an unstated mental state.
The explanation gives an unsupported reason for why the expert does not ask which law matters most.
The passage says the priest passed by, not that he did not stop at all.
The passage says the Levite passed by, but does not say he never stopped.
The passage does not say the injured man is alone.
Going toward the man is not the whole difference: the Samaritan also has compassion and cares for him.
The unqualified claim that the Samaritan does not hand the job off overlooks his later request that the innkeeper care for the man.
The passage does not say the Samaritan was riding the animal or had to find another way to travel.
Saying the Samaritan only had to lift the man up overlooks the other care he gave.
The passage does not say whether anyone went looking for the robbers.
